critical_finding.title: All artifacts declare parentArtifact but none actually consume it
critical_finding.detail: 3 of 4 core pipeline artifacts declare parentArtifact lineage, but every corresponding script independently calls pr.parsePackFile() or pr.getAllItems() to re-scan all 5 pack files from source. The `parentArtifact` field exists only as a metadata annotation — it is never used to skip or optimize scanning.
critical_finding.root_cause: This pattern is institutionalized in SESSION850_OPERATIONS_ROADMAP which prescribes 'Run all 6 engines' as the T0 step, with each engine independently scanning all pack files.

session_package_gap.detail: All 353 session packages (81 CERT, 265 INVE, 7 REME) are PENDING work orders. They contain preExecutionChecks instructing agents to re-run validators and scanner tools against pack files — effectively mandating independent re-scanning.

pack_hash_discrepancy.detail: Pack D hash differs between certification_scan_artifact.json and the other 3 pipeline artifacts. Indicates scan_artifact was generated from a different pack_d state than the pipeline artifacts.

c2_closure_recommendation: C2 SHALL CLOSE with the understanding that enforcement is a progressive deployment. The registry model is defined (S819), the violations are cataloged (S820), and the fixes are prioritized. Full enforcement is a capability that will be exercised in each future pipeline run — the immediate critical fix (Candidate Engine consuming readiness_scoring) prevents the DL-036 class of defects from recurring.
